{{Recipe}}

'''Garlic salt''' is a spice commonly found in the U.S.. It is a mixture of [[cookbook:garlic|garlic]] and [[cookbook:salt|salt]] as the name suggests. It is used on garlic bread, salads, subs, pasta, and french fries. Some also use it on chicken, hamburgers, and baked potatoes.

==Ingredients==
*1 volume of [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
*3 volumes of fine [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

==Procedure==

# Combine the garlic powder and salt. Adjusting the ratio of salt to garlic powder will alter the taste of the seasoning slightly.
